summary: Published Governance 1.14.0 (tag v1.14.0, f97de157) runs provider-mode `fsgg-governance verify` through capture, admission, whole-request resolution and planning, then always exits 1 with 'provider planning completed; execution and evidence acceptance are not connected'. SDD#928 C3.1-03 observed this against published SDD 2.4.0. Source PR #472 (merge 282741b1, prepared as Cli/FSharpSurfaceCommand 1.15.0, unpublished at capture) connects the planning to execution and acceptance. Each admitted executable binding runs once as a real child of the GateExecution held-cwd host, under the Verify host's single capture owner and original ends; the work end is capped by the declared timeout. A run is accepted only on Governance-observed fsgg.governance-handoff@2.x evidence: absent before launch, a regular non-link file, strictly parsed with sources[], citing workspace bytes Governance digests itself, and declaring passing content. Required executable capabilities that are not accepted block regardless of maturity. Product surfaces fold as in legacy Verify, and an idle lease retained past the cleanup end makes the host exit 4 rather than stay resident. Limits: the profile is cooperative and Linux-x64 only, and it needs glibc>=2.40 (older hosts report not-launched and block). Not supplied: requiredPaths coverage of evidence sources[] and the runtime carrier of the outer work/cleanup ends. Publication, both-feed readback, the installed SDD C3.1-03/C2.3 re-run, physical blocked-read/uncertain-close cases, whole-worker teardown and C3/C4 remain open; GOV-423-C2 is not complete.
title: Provider-mode Verify executes and accepts evidence in source; 1.14.0 stops after planning
